'''Torna's Cafe''' was a cafe located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. It was located at the intersection between the [[Factory District (Jorra)|Factory District]] and [[Commercial District]], which allowed it to easily find customers from both districts.
The cafe was owned by [[Hinv Opan]].<ref name="CotG" />
